visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Daytime scene at a waterfront plaza near the Kaohsiung Music Center. A large crowd of people, some with backpacks and strollers, walk across a hexagonal-patterned ground toward a massive, white inflatable character head with pink cheeks and a simple smile (Usagi from Chiikawa). The sky is a pale evening glow. (2) Night falls, showing a close-up of the same white inflatable Usagi character floating in the harbor water, its features lit from within. In the background, the hexagonal structures of the music center are brilliantly lit with rotating rainbow colors. (3) A blue and white inflatable character (Hachiware) is shown floating on the water at night. People stand on the shore as dark silhouettes, taking photos with their phones against the shimmering reflection of the city lights. (4) A large, round yellow rabbit inflatable (Usagi) sits on a paved area, illuminated by bright floodlights and protected by a red velvet rope. Families and children are visible in the background, enjoying the night festivities. (5) Fast cuts of brightly lit amusement rides including a helicopter-shaped ride and a miniature train decorated like a Parisian street, complete with a lit-up Eiffel Tower replica. (6) A green and white light rail train (KLRT-04) pulls into a modern station at night, its sides wrapped in colorful Chiikawa character graphics as passengers wait on the platform.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy, hyper-pop J-Pop background music begins, featuring high-pitched, child-like female voices (Chiikawa characters) singing a repetitive, bouncy melody with Japanese lyrics. The beat is a bright electronic four-on-the-floor rhythm with synthesized pops and bubble sounds. (2) The music continues seamlessly, maintaining a consistent 132 BPM. A subtle background ambient hum of an outdoor harbor environment is barely audible under the dominant music track. The vocal contour is playful and rising, conveying high emotional arousal and positivity. (3) Near the end of the video, as the light rail scene appears, a faint mechanical whirring and a muffled bell chime from the train are integrated into the ambient layer, while the cheerful character-driven pop song continues at full volume until the cut.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional guide for the '2025 Kaohsiung Winter Wonderland' event. It uses the popular Chiikawa IP to attract viewers, showing the locations of character inflatables, amusement park activities, and specific details about free ticket collection and transportation via the themed light rail.
